summary: Weather/environment state initializer run on game restart (called by Game_Restart). Destroys prior weather list state, clears this[7], and takes an early-out path (this[5]=0) when the display-mode flag is unset or dword_8AB6E4 is 2. Otherwise selects a weather parameter mode: either a season-race weather entry found via StringKeyedLinkedListSearch on aWeather_1, a weather.txt file parsed via sub_4FE7C0, or a built-in mode float chosen by a switch on dword_7CF080. Allocates a 4-float parameter array ([0, 1101004800, modeValue, 0]) stored at this[15], feeds its third value to sub_4FDE00, copies derived values into this[9..13], processes the audio ring buffer around a saved copy of this+0x20, initializes per-race flags/words at +0x40..0x52, seeds this+0x104 from a rotation table, calls RangeInterpolationTable, and conditionally resets a name string at this+0x1C4 and calls sub_4FC550.

local_names.v3: weather config/section parse result (0 on failure)
local_names.v13: selected weather mode float constant (switch on dword_7CF080)

Call DisplayModeSetter(0x20000) on the early-out path.

Return result (DisplayModeSetter return value cast to char*) on the early-out path.

Set *(float*)this = flt_8ACF9C when byte_7CF17C is nonzero, otherwise *this = 1065353216 (1.0f).
Branch on dword_7CF080: nonzero selects the section/file weather path, zero selects the weather.txt file path.
Call SeasonRacesSectionFinder(0) to locate the current season races section when dword_7CF080 is 1.
Call StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(aWeather_1) to find the weather linked-list node for the season races section.
Fallback path (LABEL_15): select weather mode constant v13 by switch on dword_7CF080 — case 3: 1059481190; case 4: 1062333317; case 5: 1064346583; default: 1050253722.
Call DualLinkedListDestruction(this) to tear down the weather parameter list before rebuilding.

Call FloatArrayInitializer(v5) to initialize the allocated array when v5 is nonzero; else v6 = 0.
Call sub_4FDE00 with the float at this[15]+8 (the selected mode value v13).
Set this[10] = this[9] and this[11] = this[9] (propagate the config value into two slots).
Set *((float*)this + 12) and *((float*)this + 13) both to the float at this[15]+4 (array[1]).
Call sub_4FE350(v2) with the season weather linked-list node v2 (when the section/list search succeeded).
Compute base path v4 = dword_5EC438, or byte_5EA438 when dword_5EC438 is 0.
Call StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v15, "%sweather.txt", v4) to build the weather file path.
Call sub_4FE7C0(v15) to parse the weather.txt file into v3 (parse result).
If v3 (parse result) is nonzero, jump to LABEL_15 (fallback weather mode constants).
LABEL_26: save a 24-byte copy of this+0x20 into local v14 before audio processing (qmemcpy(v14, this + 8, 24)).
Call AudioEventRingBufferProcessing(this) to process the weather audio ring buffer.
Restore this+0x20 from v14 (qmemcpy of 0x18 bytes), then set this[2] = this[8] and this[14] = this[15] (saved array pointer).
Set *((_BYTE*)this + 64) = 1 (initialization-complete byte flag).
Set this[17] = -8388609 and this[1] = 0.
Initialize word block: word at +36 = 0, +37 = -1, +38 = -1, +39 = 0, +40 = 0x7FFF, +41 = 0x8000.
Call DisplayModeSetter(0x20000) again after field initialization.
Set this[5] = (*((float*)this + 11) > 0.0) — a boolean derived from this[11] (field at +0x2C).
Compute v11 = flt_8AB274[(unsigned __int8)dword_8AAE70++] * 0.050000001 (rotation-table value scaled by 0.05).
Set *((float*)this + 65) = v11 (float field at this+0x104).
Call RangeInterpolationTable(this) and use its return as result.

Call strcmp((const char*)this + 452, byte_8ACFA3) to test whether the stored name string already matches.
On mismatch, call sub_587DD0(this + 113, byte_8ACFA3, 11) to copy byte_8ACFA3 into the name field.
Set *((_BYTE*)this + 463) = 0 (null-terminate the name field at this+0x1CF).
Call sub_4FC550((int)(this + 66), 1) and return its result on the name-reset path.
Return result (RangeInterpolationTable or sub_4FC550 return value).
